roles.title: Inbox
roles.inputs: Intact arrivals
roles.work: Observe stable source bytes, hash and propose membership/routes.
roles.boundary: Unstable or ambiguous sources remain on HOLD.

roles.title: AI Crew and Review
roles.inputs: Reads, reviews, votes, concerns and contributions
roles.work: Queue exact-edition reviews, append votes/issues and evaluate explicit policy.
roles.outputs: Review queue, issue history, attribution and pending decisions
roles.boundary: Read is not agreement; a model cannot sign for David.

roles.title: Structure and Navigation
roles.inputs: Standards, manifests, templates and navigation
roles.work: Validate manifests and role applicability; generate navigation and Bases.
roles.boundary: Do not rename existing folders or create 21 roles inside every paper.

roles.title: Canonical Selection
roles.inputs: Actual authorized edition selections
roles.work: Validate ruling provenance and exact selected edition; show pending recommendations.
roles.boundary: A successful API call, CAN folder or confidence score does not admit canon.

roles.title: Paradigm and Synthesis
roles.inputs: Integrated argument and alternatives
roles.work: Prepare bounded synthesis tasks and identify missing joins.
roles.boundary: Generated synthesis remains a draft.

roles.title: The Case
roles.inputs: Claims and their whole supporting/challenging case
roles.work: Link claims to assumptions, evidence, falsifiers, objections and exact proofs; report stale support.
roles.boundary: Use addressable sections initially; split independent records when needed, not every sentence.

roles.title: Intellectual History
roles.inputs: Earlier models and documented changes
roles.work: Track explicit predecessor/successor and attributed reasons.
roles.boundary: Newest timestamp is not authority; inferred lineage stays proposed.

roles.title: Mathematics and Operators
roles.inputs: Equations, derivations, operators and translations
roles.work: Check declared fields/versions, units/domains and prepare mathematical review.
roles.boundary: Field completion is not mathematical validity. Preserve compiler/project layout.

roles.title: Theology and Scripture
roles.inputs: Passage uses, interpretations, doctrine and witnesses
roles.work: Resolve shared passages, compare quoted spans and index local uses.
roles.boundary: Passage, interpretation and proposed mathematical correspondence retain separate standing.

roles.title: Terms and Definitions
roles.inputs: Shared sense versions and local uses
roles.work: Resolve senses and detect proposed new or conflicting definitions.
roles.boundary: Do not merge different senses or infer agreement from repeated words.

roles.title: Research and Sources
roles.inputs: Dossiers, source records, passages and literature
roles.work: Index acquisition/provenance and check locators; propose support relationships.
roles.boundary: Resolving a citation or matching a quote does not establish relevance or support.

roles.title: Writing and Editions
roles.inputs: Drafts, articles and work editions
roles.work: Retain edition observations and explicit lineage; assemble writing packets.
roles.boundary: Do not automatically rewrite manuscripts or merge distinct works by title.

roles.title: Reader Versions and Responses
roles.inputs: Reading levels, FAQs and speaker responses
roles.work: Prepare audience projections from permitted source-bound claims.
roles.boundary: Do not invent quotations or remove source qualifications.

roles.title: Stories and Quotations
roles.inputs: Illustration, satire, testimony and quotations
roles.work: Index story uses/provenance and prepare story/quote tasks.
roles.boundary: Invented stories illustrate, not empirical evidence; historical accounts need evidence assessment.

roles.title: ORBITS Analysis
roles.inputs: Existing six core, twelve condition and ten spiritual fields
roles.work: Validate the versioned 28-field contract and source/actor/recipient/response distinctions.
roles.boundary: Do not invent missing field definitions or reduce the full contract to its ten spiritual fields.

roles.title: Media and Assets
roles.inputs: Audio, video, images, slides, captions and uses
roles.work: Inventory/probe assets and report empty/missing files and unresolved parents.
roles.boundary: A readable audio stream is not a reviewed transcript. Preserve asset packages.

roles.title: Runs and Verification Receipts
roles.inputs: Formal, computational and other execution records
roles.work: Check exact code/input/output bindings, toolchain, assumptions and current applicability.
roles.boundary: A failed run can be fully executed; compile success is scoped to exact statements/assumptions.

roles.title: Private Audit
roles.inputs: Restricted findings and private review bodies
roles.work: Enforce default exclusion from exports/model bundles, including indirect leaks.
roles.boundary: A privacy label alone does not enforce privacy; exports need an allowlist.

roles.title: Publication and Export
roles.inputs: Rendered pages and release/export packets
roles.work: Generate common-snapshot Markdown/HTML/Bases/maps with versioned manifests.
roles.boundary: Rendering is not publication permission. No automatic deploy or external posting.

roles.title: Gaps and Missing Work
roles.inputs: Unresolved requirements, stale inputs and next tasks
roles.work: Compute gaps using applicability and records, not physical folder presence alone.
roles.boundary: Unknown/unavailable is not zero; unused optional roles are not automatically failures.

roles.title: Superseded Editions
roles.inputs: Retained retired sources and explicit replacements
roles.work: Show retirement/supersession events and link to prior exact editions.
roles.boundary: No deletion, ID reuse or automatic latest-wins selection.
